title: If Statement
concept: The if statement lets your program make decisions — executing code only when a condition is true.
why: Without if, every program would do the same thing every time. If brings intelligence and decision-making to your code.
tips: The condition inside `if` MUST be a Bool — `true` or `false`
Indent the code inside `if` for readability (XIOM doesn't care, but humans do)
You can have as many `if` statements as you want
Each `if` is independent — multiple `if`s can all run
common_mistakes: Using `=` instead of `==`: `if x = 5` is an assignment, not a comparison
No Bool condition: `if 42` is invalid — write `if 42 != 0` instead
Forgetting the braces `{ }` — the body must be inside curly braces
